mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.1%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a decline in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals an accelerating economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods within a monetary easing cycle where CPIAUCSL declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in the real economy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 950.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 950.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a sharp deterioration in the labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of more than 0.25 percentage points from the prior month signals aggressive monetary tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods within a high inflation regime where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25%.
